use.extraction_logic: If there is only one property/risk, set to 'Principal'. If multiple properties/risks exist, follow Quote assignment for each property (e.g., Principal vs Secondary).

owned_resided_since.extraction_logic: Extract from Dwelling Information -> Occupied Since. Output in YYYY-MM-DD format.
owned_resided_since.description: Client has owned/resided at this location since (YYYY-MM-DD)

fire_hydrant_within_300m.extraction_logic: Default to 'Yes' for Homeowner unless explicit contrary evidence is present.

fire_hall.extraction_logic: Default to 'Within 13km' for Homeowner unless explicit contrary evidence is present.

building_type.extraction_logic: Extract from Dwelling Information -> Structure. Use keyword/fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option.

construction_type.extraction_logic: Extract from Dwelling Information -> Construction. Use keyword/fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed option.

number_of_units_in_building.extraction_logic: Read from Application first. If not found in Application, output null.

occupancy_status.extraction_logic: Default to 'Occupied' for Homeowner unless explicit contrary evidence is present.

smokers_reside_at_this_location.extraction_logic: From Quote header/intro, read 'Smoke-Free Household'. This field asks whether SMOKERS reside — it is the INVERSE of Smoke-Free. If Smoke-Free Household is 'Yes', output 'No' here. If Smoke-Free Household is 'No', output 'Yes'. Do NOT copy the Smoke-Free answer directly.

year_built.extraction_logic: Extract from Dwelling Information -> Year Dwelling Build. Output YYYY.

year_of_manufacture.extraction_logic: Extract from Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Year of Manufacture (value above the label). Output 4-digit year YYYY only. If blank, unavailable, or not applicable, output null.

total_living_area.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Total Living Area. Read the value shown above the label (e.g. '1691 sq. ft.') and output the numeric portion only as a positive integer with no units or decimals. If blank or unavailable, output null.
total_living_area.description: Total living area excluding basement (natural number only)

total_living_area_unit.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Total Living Area. Read the unit from the same field as total_living_area and map to one allowed option: 'sq. ft.', 'sq ft', 'square feet' -> 'Sq Feet'; 'sq. m.', 'sq m', 'square meters' -> 'Sq Meters'. Use LLM fuzzy matching when the source wording differs slightly.

number_of_bathrooms.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information only. Read Number of Full Baths and Number of Half Baths (values above each label). Calculate: Number of Full Baths + (0.5 × Number of Half Baths). Example: 3 full + 1 half -> '3.5'. Map the calculated result to one allowed dropdown option.

percent_finished.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Finished Basement. Read the value above the label (e.g. '100%'), strip the '%' symbol, and output an integer from 0 to 100. If blank or unavailable, output null.

garage_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Garage. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Built-in'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option. Example: 'Built-in' -> 'Built in'.

primary_heat_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Primary Heating -> Type. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Central Furnace - Gas'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed option. Example: 'Central Furnace - Gas' -> 'Forced Air Furnace'.

security_or_mitigation_system.extraction_logic: From security section, inspect Burglar Alarm, Fire Alarm, and 24 Hour Video System. Ignore values that indicate none/no/blank. If all three are none/no/blank, output null. Otherwise output a single string that concatenates only present concrete items, e.g. 'Burglar Alarm: XXXX, Fire Alarm: XXXX'.

electrical_wiring_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Type of Electrical. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Copper'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option.

panel_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Electrical Panel. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Breakers'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option.

amperage.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Electrical Service. Read the value above the label (e.g. '100 AMP'), extract the numeric portion, strip 'AMP', and map to one allowed option. Use 'Other' when the source value does not match 60, 100, 125, or 200.

plumbing_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Type of Plumbing. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Mixed – Copper/PVC'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option. Example: 'Mixed – Copper/PVC' -> 'Copper / PVC'.

roof_covering_type.extraction_logic: Quote -> Dwelling Information -> Type of Roof. Read the value above the label (e.g. 'Asphalt Shingles'). Use LLM fuzzy matching to map source text to one allowed Homeowner option.
options: Class 4 Rated Impact Resistant Asphalt Shingles

date_evaluation_completed.extraction_logic: Quote -> Policy Information -> Last Home Evaluation. Read the value above the label and output in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: '02/24/2026' -> '2026-02-24'. If blank or unavailable, output null.

rebuilding_cost.extraction_logic: Quote -> Policy Information -> Dwelling Value. Read the value above the label (e.g. '$728,700'). Strip currency symbols and commas; output the numeric amount only. If blank or unavailable, output null.

interest.extraction_logic: All subfields under interest must be sourced from Application (not Quote).

has_loan.extraction_logic: Application source only. Extract whether there is an interested party/loan/credit/mortgage associated with this risk. Must be 'Yes' or 'No'.
has_loan.description: Whether there is an interested party

type_of_interest.extraction_logic: Application source only. Extract type of interest. Select one option from the configured list.

company_name.extraction_logic: Application source only. Extract interested party company or organization name.

address.extraction_logic: Application source only. Extract full mailing address for the interested party.

postal_code.extraction_logic: Application source only. Extract Canadian postal code for the interested party.
